summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Version 13.0.7 of @ornikar/jest-config declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`, and setup.mjs uses `_0x`-style identifier and string-array obfuscation to construct a URL under https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, download the Bun runtime zip into the OS tmpdir, extract it, chmod +x, and then execFileSync the freshly-downloaded Bun binary against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte file (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) beginning `// @bun @bun-cjs` and consisting almost entirely of a shuffled numeric string-array with rotated `_0x` dispatch — a Bun-compiled obfuscated payload. The package's documented purpose is a Jest configuration preset; the shipped `jest-preset.js` never references `math_init.js`, and a Jest preset has no need for an alternate language runtime or a 700KB obfuscated bytecode blob. The preinstall path fetches an alternate runtime specifically to execute opaque, non-Node-readable bytes on every `npm install`, matching the alternate-runtime-dropper shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
